socfpga_ccu.h

Cache Coherency Unit (CCU) hardware abstraction driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

The CCU manages the system-level interconnect cache, providing mechanisms to ensure data coherency between the HPS (Hard Processor System), the FPGA fabric, and the system memory (DDR). This driver facilitates the flushing of L3 system cache lines, the monitoring of interconnect error status, and raw register access for advanced diagnostic and configuration tasks.

socfpga_ccu_get_id
int32_t socfpga_ccu_get_id(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
*
id
)

Retrieves the hardware peripheral identification and revision code from the CCU's component ID registers.

This is primarily used during driver initialization to verify that the memory-mapped base address corresponds to the expected CCU hardware revision.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The physical MMIO base address of the CCU block.

id
uint32_t*

Pointer to store the 32-bit hardware identification value.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the pointer is null or the address is invalid.

socfpga_ccu_get_error_status
int32_t socfpga_ccu_get_error_status(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
*
status
)

Reads the CCU Uncorrected Error Status register.

This register tracks fatal interconnect fault events, such as bus protocol violations, slave access errors, or memory-mapped coherency faults.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The physical MMIO base address of the CCU block.

status
uint32_t*

Pointer to store the 32-bit error status bitmask.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the pointer is null.

socfpga_ccu_flush_l3_cache
int32_t socfpga_ccu_flush_l3_cache(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
timeout_polls
)

Performs a global flush of the L3 system-memory cache entries.

This function is critical for maintaining system coherency before DMA transfers or system resets. It iterates through the enabled DMI (Direct Memory Interface) ports, issuing maintenance commands to force data synchronization between the L3 cache and the underlying DDR memory.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The physical MMIO base address of the CCU block.

timeout_polls
uint32_t

The maximum number of iterations to poll the hardware status register while waiting for the flush operation to confirm completion.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if input parameters are out of range; -ETIMEDOUT if the maintenance operation fails to acknowledge completion within the allotted polling count.

Performs a direct 32-bit Memory-Mapped I/O (MMIO) read from an arbitrary register offset within the CCU instance.

Parameters

uint32_t

The physical MMIO base address of the CCU block.

offset
uint32_t

The 32-bit aligned register offset to query.

value
uint32_t*

Pointer to store the 32-bit hardware register value.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the provided pointer is null.
